messages.content: Who won the chess tournament in 2015?

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

message.content: Could you clarify which chess tournament you’re referring to? For example, were you asking about the World Chess Championship, the World Cup, or another event from 2015?
message.reasoning: User asks: "Who won the chess tournament in 2015?" This is ambiguous: which tournament? Could be World Chess Championship 2015? That was held in 2015: Magnus Carlsen defended his title against Sergey Karjakin. So winner: Magnus Carlsen. But maybe they refer to some other tournament like the World Cup? The 2015 World Cup winner was Sergey Karjakin. Or maybe they refer to the 2015 Chess Olympiad? That was won by Russia. But likely they mean the World Chess Championship 2015. We need to ask clarifying question. According to policy, we should ask clarifying question.
